svg.title: White Curve
svg.desc: Schematic visual study after the cited photograph. Approximate geometry and interpretive colors; wall and cast shadows omitted. Same historical White Curve1972 now called White Triangle with Black Curve. White triangular canvas and black corner slivers retained; upper-left wall omitted. Curvature approximate. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
